description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art head, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: put the same thing on both heads, in the same place on each: two big round solid brown bear ears, each about as big as an eye, with a lighter brown inner circle, standing on top of the head on a thick brown headband (seen from behind, the two big round solid brown bear ears on their thick headband, seen from behind). Simple bold shapes. Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The head, the face and the ears stay exactly as they are, nothing else added, transparent background.
